title: The same request during a Wi-Fi outage

trace.user_message: I enabled Wi-Fi and forgot the saved network, but Campus-Demo still will not connect. Check whether Wi-Fi is down. If it is operating, prepare a ticket about this problem.

nodes.final_answer:
The Wi-Fi service is **down**. There's a campus-wide outage, and no repair time is available.

You asked for a ticket only if Wi-Fi was working, so **I didn't prepare one**. Since the whole service is down, the connection problem with Campus-Demo is most likely caused by the outage and not by your device.

If you still want a ticket draft about the problem, I can make one that notes the outage.
